description: Must be an individual or group micro food processing enterprise
Beneficiary must contribute at least 10% of eligible project cost
Maximum credit-linked capital subsidy capped at Rs 10 Lakhs
Remaining project balance must be funded via commercial bank loan
Must be commercial orchard plantation or accredited hi-tech nursery
Planting material and infrastructure must adhere to NHB accreditation
Must be post-harvest sorting grading packing or cold storage facility
Project must satisfy official NCCD/NHB technical specifications
Applicant must be establishing a new micro-enterprise unit
Manufacturing project cost must not exceed Rs 50 Lakhs
Service project cost must not exceed Rs 20 Lakhs
Must be off-grid or grid-connected solar agricultural irrigation pump
Farmer must hold valid 7/12 land extract and open water source
